about:
Colorado Custom Metalwork Inc. operates from Denver, Colorado. The family-owned business has accumulated decades of experience in custom metal fabrication, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. The company was established to bring craftsmanship and creativity together for bespoke metalwork solutions.

The shop specializes in custom metal fabrication for residential and commercial spaces, producing gates, railings, architectural elements, floating and curved staircases, spiral staircases, and baby or dog gates. All products receive a powder-coated finish for durability and weather resistance. The team handles design, fabrication, and finishing in-house, though facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Clients range from homeowners seeking custom railings or staircases to commercial projects needing architectural metalwork. A testimonial from a Wheat Ridge resident highlights residential work, while the company's portfolio includes both residential and commercial installations.

The company emphasizes its family-owned, locally crafted approach, free consultations and estimates, fast turnaround, and an experienced team as key differentiators. It positions itself on delivering functional, visually stunning pieces built to last.
